messages:
Kaya (Sales): Nimbus legal flagged perf and security Qs. Their POC shows intermittent first-byte spikes (700-1.1s) under bursty chat load. Can we swarm and give concise troubleshooting steps and QA bullets for legal?
Dev (Nimbus): Load: 30 concurrent chat sessions, avg input 100 tokens, reply ~70 tokens. Region: us-east-1. We saw a couple 429s and 'kv_cache_miss' entries. Sample id: req_20260710_ffa2.
Sam (SE): Which model and deployment? Streaming on/off? 429s often from per-second concurrency caps.
Dev (Nimbus): Hosted API, model rwinf-redwood-13b-v2, streaming=true for prod. The failing sample used stream=true.
Rina (Eng-Oncall): Quick look: req_20260710_ffa2 shows batch_size=40 queue_ms=360 exec_ms=300 kv_cache_miss=true. Main contributor is queue_ms — batching too large for chat.
Sam (SE): Immediate recommendation: set max_batch_size=12 min_batch_timeout_ms=2 and enable prefix caching + a warmup of ~100 tokens x 10 requests. Also measure with stream=false to get raw first-token latency.
Kaya (Sales): Can you give a 1-2 line runbook for the customer to paste?
Sam (SE): Paste this overlay in Console -> POC overrides:
```
batching:
  max_batch_size: 12
  min_batch_timeout_ms: 2
cache:
  prefix_cache: true
  warmup_requests: 10
```
Rina (Eng-Oncall): After warmup expect p50 drop from ~800ms to ~220-300ms. If 429s persist check per-second concurrency limit, we can request a burst raise or suggest Dedicated.
Tom (Security): For legal bullets: Hosted with optional Dedicated/Private, support for customer-managed KMS, SOC2 Type II, and ability to route logs to customer S3. I'll drop a short Q&A.
Dev (Nimbus): Applying overlay now and switching to stream=false for test.
ops-bot: Deployment started for rwinf-redwood-13b-v2 -> canary-2026-07-10
Rina (Eng-Oncall): Post-overlay quick numbers (non-streaming, after warmup): p50=260ms p95=420ms p99=640ms. No 429s in 10m window.
Dev (Nimbus): That's a clear improvement. We'll rerun our full load test and share results.
Kaya (Sales): Action items: @Sam validate quantized variant on 20 prompts (owner Sam) - EOD; @Rina keep overlay live for POC; @Tom post Q&A bullets (owner Tom); @Dev re-run load and paste p50/p95/p99.
Dev (Nimbus): Will do. Thanks for the quick help.
(END)
